mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) may potentiate systemic corticosteroid effects and increase risk of hypertension, hyperglycemia, and immunosuppression; budesonide undergoes hepatic metabolism which could be affected by MAOI activity.
action: Monitor blood pressure, glucose levels, and signs of infection during concurrent use; consider alternative antidepressant if possible; use lowest effective budesonide dose.
